semantics.explicit_rule: Applicable machine-significant semantics must be represented explicitly rather than left to naming convention.
semantics.empty_rule: Empty sections are allowed only when semantically valid and intentional.
semantics.finding_rule: Missing required semantic dimension produces conformance finding.
semantics.human_rule: Human-readable explanation remains available for meaningful contracts.
semantics.authority_rule: Completeness score/status has no runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.

references.purpose: Completeness covers both machine and human representation.
